name: tutor
title_zh: 把 Obsidian 笔记变成自适应测验的私教
tagline_zh: 学完就忘？让它先诊断再出题，专攻你的薄弱点。不是随机抽题，是每次测验都比上次更懂你哪里不会。
tagline_en: Stop forgetting what you learn. It diagnoses first, then drills your exact weak spots. Not random quizzes—each.
desc_en: Interactive quiz tutor for Obsidian StudyVault learning. Use when the user wants to: (1) Take a diagnostic assessment of their knowledge, (2) Study or review specific sections/topics, (3) Drill weak areas identified in previous sessions, (4) Check their learning progress or dashboard, or says things like "quiz me", "test me", "let's study", "/tutor", "학습", "퀴즈", "평가".
why_zh: 它不按章节顺序出题，而是先跑诊断、再按你的错误模式动态选题，把每次测验变成一次针对性的知识修复。
why_en: No chapter-order quizzes. It runs a diagnostic first, then selects questions based on your error patterns—turning each test into.
limit_zh: 只认 Obsidian 的 StudyVault 库结构，笔记需带标签或 MOC 链接；不解析 PDF/网页。
limit_en: Requires Obsidian StudyVault structure with tagged notes or MOC links; no PDF/web parsing. Results stay in-vault; sync across devices is on you.
